demo_16x9.title: RowArchiver — Automated Conditional Row Archiving & Google Sheets Speed Optimizer: Keep Your Live Google Sheets Sub-Second Fast—Without Deleting Historical Data (Full Walkthrough)
demo_16x9.transcript: Need a better way to handle archiving completed spreadsheet rows to keep live trackers fast, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch RowArchiver in action: Moves completed rows from the bottom up with built-in concurrency locking so active row indexes and adjacent formulas never shift or corrupt. Preview the exact count of rows matching your rule (such as Status = "Completed" or Date older than 30 days) before moving a single cell. Plus, set an automatic overnight or hourly schedule so completed tasks evacuate to your Archive tab while your team sleeps. Automatically creates your destination Archive tab with matching column headers and formatting—100% inside your own Google Sheet. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
